capabilities: Collect notes, PDFs, images, audio, and video on boards
Build mind maps with parent-child and bidirectional links
Browse cards in list, table, and Kanban views
Create highlight notes from PDF selections and media timestamps
Arrange chapters and generate Markdown drafts
extras: Local-only; PNG/PDF export omits embedded raster images, PDF page pixels, and handwriting ink; mobile hardware unverified.
problem: Research notes, source excerpts, and drafts live in separate files and views, making it hard to connect evidence and turn it into long-form writing.
summary: Visual research workspace that combines Markdown whiteboards, mind maps, card views, PDF and media highlights, and a writing studio for drafts.
